target_kind: Explicit Gaussian approximation to the rounded published joint Ly-alpha AP+BAO distance summaries, not an exact author likelihood or raw-forest reconstruction.

printed_summary.rounding_role: All32 corners of the five printed-number rounding intervals, with fixed lexicographic ordering. These form a finite numerical sensitivity exercise, not a probability distribution, strict interior envelope, missing-tail model or systematic allowance.

replacement: Select the two z=2.33 parent rows by named DM/DH observables, require exactly zero covariance with the other11 rows, preserve their marginal block, and replace the overlapping pair by Eq26. Never add the old Ly-alpha BAO factor or a separate broadbandAP factor. No f-sigma8, H0, BBN or acoustic-angle prior is added.
density_convention: Retain the Cobaya BAO convention logL=-chi2/2; constant Gaussian determinants do not affect any within-target posterior. No evidence ratio or author significance is inferred.
background: Same physical CAMB parameters and drag sound horizon as the parent. One no-spectra native-thermal background per point evaluates DA and H at all13 original row redshifts, restoring row order. DM=(1+z)DA; DH=c/H; DV=(z*DM^2*DH)^(1/3).
parent_and_child_gates: Fresh measurement_summary parent qualification before work. All2000 original selected points, four independent chains, untrimmed exact/proposal weights plus new-minus-old fullBAO density. The unchanged luminosity-sensitivity-design overlap gates apply separately to nominal and every rounding corner; failed variants admit no posterior. Native precision is separately qualified.
validation: Independent full-matrix Gaussian quadratics; DM/DH row permutation; covariance-block rejection; direct native likelihood interface with fake distance provider; normalized determinant shift constant; same-factor replacement and known Gaussian posterior reweighting; cache/input tampering and failed-parent refusal before any background.
limits: The public printed moments do not establish compressed-likelihood Gaussian tails or its nuisance-prior measure. Raw DR2 forest data and an author machine likelihood were not located in the checked public interfaces at retrieval. Conditioning remains on the published template, metal/HCD/redshift/UV response and small-scale marginalization; the mocks exclude a biased growth-rate estimate. Our unchanged CMB and SN choices differ from the paper. This is an approximate sensitivity measurement with no empirical progenitor-age correction or author3.2sigma reproduction claim.
